verdict.rationale: Adyen's own reporting docs offer a visual view of balances, sales, and payouts, and the Customer Area gives an overview of transactions, so some first-party payout reporting exists. Nothing in the pack shows itemized settlement reports or matching payouts to bank deposits. missing for 10: itemized settlement/reconciliation reports, fee breakdowns, refund and chargeback line items, a payout-to-bank-deposit matching workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
